name: MongoDB
subtitle: Document database (NoSQL)
creator: 10gen (Dwight Merriman, Eliot Horowitz, Kevin Ryan)
description: Stores data as flexible JSON-like documents in collections, with no fixed schema required. It offers rich queries, secondary indexes, an aggregation pipeline, multi-document transactions and horizontal sharding. Atlas, its managed cloud, adds search and vector search.

languages.youWrite: MongoDB Query Language through drivers, often with Mongoose

concepts.explanation: The binary format documents are stored in.
Optional validation instead of fixed columns.

codeSamples.label: MongoDB shell

cons: Relational data and joins are awkward
Schema discipline moves into app code

pricing.summary: Atlas: free M0 cluster (512 MB). Flex: $8 to $30/mo, capped. Dedicated from about $0.08/hr (about $57/mo for M10).

surveys.source: Stack Overflow Developer Survey 2025, all respondents
